description: The browser-agent extensions on Linux, matched by id, from the Web Store's signed CRX.
why: Each browser agent on Linux, where nothing proved one before. An extension id is derived from its manifest key, so it is the same on every OS; the id is each agent's only witness here. `forbid` keeps Claude's extension from being read as the same vendor's CLI or desktop app.
known_gaps: Chrome for Testing registers the extensions. Branded Chrome's own install and ExtensionInstallForcelist, which a managed fleet uses, are untested.
x86_64 only: Google ships no Linux arm64 Chrome, so the arm64 runner skips this.
